title: System Metrics Collection
summary: This module is responsible for collecting and exposing system-level metrics, providing insights into the application's operational health and performance.

nodes.label: Collect and Snapshot Metrics
nodes.title: Collect and Snapshot Metrics
nodes.description: Initializes the metrics collector, increments counters, sets gauge values, and captures a snapshot of the current metrics state for logging and analysis.

nodes.label: Metrics Collector
nodes.title: Metrics Collector
nodes.description: An internal component that manages and aggregates various types of metrics, such as counters and gauges, allowing for their collection and snapshotting.

nodes.label: Logging System
nodes.title: Logging System
nodes.description: The application's centralized logging infrastructure used to record operational events, metric snapshots, and debugging information.

groups.label: Metrics Collection Process
groups.title: Metrics Collection Process
groups.description: Encapsulates the core logic for initializing, updating, and capturing system metrics within the module.
